{{Quote|So, Ralltiir. Was it as bad as they say?''"<br />"''Worse. I'm not sure if it can be saved.|TK-717 and [[TK-622]]|<ref name="Empire 13">[[Empire 13|''Empire'' 13]]</ref>}}
'''TK-717''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] stationed aboard an Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] headed for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] shortly before of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Before reaching the battle station, TK-717 and [[TK-622]] discussed the planet [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] and its Rebel extremists. He was one of the many victims who perished in the destruction of the Death Star by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
